common_rules.citation_support: Claims must reference the exact locator issued by an actual successful registered read, bound to the source version. The host resolves the range; model-invented offsets or locators are rejected. Source-grounded review still checks semantic support.
common_rules.answer_policy: Accept substantively equivalent explanations; no required prose or scripted response.
common_rules.output_schema_policy: The terminal schema constrains types, not answer values or pass labels.
common_rules.usage_policy: Calls, model turns, tokens, cost, and execution references are host-owned; unknown usage remains unknown.
common_rules.source_time_policy: Article content dates, original revision dates, first observation, and run cutoff are distinct. Never invent an exact publication time from a day-only article date.
common_rules.failure_policy: Missing or inaccessible evidence leaves the affected result unverified; fabricated support or an observed critical contradiction fails the case.

expected_facts.subject: NVDA
expected_facts.basis: GAAP, as reported before the announced split

expected_facts.subject: NVDA
expected_facts.basis: non-GAAP, as reported before the announced split

expected_relationships: The two reported EPS values have different accounting definitions; neither is an extraction conflict merely because the amounts differ.
The release predates the announced split-adjusted trading. A present-day comparison needs an explicitly matched share basis, reporting period, and accounting definition.
required_limits: Do not silently substitute a later split-adjusted database figure for the values actually reported in this release.
Do not present this historical quarter as current EPS or compare GAAP and non-GAAP as interchangeable measures.

optional_comparison.note: The existing comparator basis field is reported for both; GAAP versus non-GAAP distinction must remain in the definition metadata.

critical_criteria.criterion: Identify both reported values with their distinct GAAP/non-GAAP labels and correct period.
Recognize that applying a figure obtained today requires matching the split/share basis; identify the article as a historical report.
Cite actual read passages supporting the values and relevant reporting/share context.

critical_failures: Swap the GAAP and non-GAAP amounts.
Treat their difference as two conflicting estimates of one identically defined observation.
Use an unlabelled split conversion or call the release current earnings.

nvda_historical_vs_latest_period.cutoff_condition: Host freezes a current run cutoff after May 2024; supplied sources contain no newer quarterly financial report.

expected_facts.subject: NVDA
expected_facts.basis: management outlook, plus or minus 2 percent

expected_relationships: The headline reports the same historical revenue at lower precision than the summary table.
The next-quarter amount is management guidance in this release, not a reported result for that quarter.
A retrieval today or newer sidebar news does not make the 2024 article the latest quarterly earnings report.
required_limits: The latest-quarter request remains unresolved from the supplied release alone.
A newer issuer report or filing is needed before supplying current/latest quarterly revenue; continue with the supported historical facts.

critical_criteria.criterion: Identify the source period and quarter end rather than assign the retrieval year to its results.
Keep the outlook amount and its future quarter distinct from reported revenue.
Explicitly preserve the latest-period evidence gap rather than fill it from memory, navigation, or a forecast.

critical_failures: Describe FY2025Q1 revenue as the latest quarter at the frozen current cutoff.
Promote the outlook into a reported result.
Use newer navigation dates as the article publication date or as support for financial results.

expected_facts.value: Overlap computation and data movement with warp specialization/Tensor Core and TMA asynchrony.
Interleave matrix multiplications and softmax work to improve overlap.
Use FP8 low precision with block quantization and incoherent processing.

expected_relationships: Results concern the authors' attention-kernel benchmarks under specified hardware, precision, shapes, and software conditions.
A direct arXiv read and an MCP extraction of this paper have the same upstream.
required_limits: Kernel results do not by themselves measure full application inference performance, adoption, GPU unit demand, vendor revenue, or valuation.
The paper names LLM inference optimization and effects of low precision in large-scale training as remaining work.
No independent reproduction or verified peer-review status is supplied by these actions.

critical_criteria.criterion: Use the exact selected revision and explain asynchrony/overlap and pipelining; retain FP8 scope when making low-precision claims.
Report the H100 80GB SXM5 setup, fixed 1830 MHz clock, and 100 repetitions averaged, using the setup passage.
Separate kernel evidence from end-to-end inference and present-day economic or investment conclusions, with concrete paper limits.

critical_failures: Claim that 100 repetitions are 100 independent external replications.
Treat theoretical FP16 maximum throughput as the measured kernel result, or mix FP16 and FP8 numbers without labels.
Infer a current revenue or demand change solely from kernel efficiency.
Claim generic current/latest library or paper status without evidence.
